MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 33 of the Securities Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Listing Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (Listing Regulations), we are enclosing the statement of Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for quarter ended June 30, 2026 duly approved by the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on August 13, 2026. 
We also enclosed herewith a copy of the Limited Review Report of the Auditors of the Company as required under Regulation 33 of the Listing Regulations.
NEWSSUB: Statement Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026 Of The Company
